answers.question: platform D2: no platform edges (which side the trains stop at)
answers.answer: D2 is not a train platform: in Östgötatrafiken's stop overview for Norrköpings resecentrum, D1 and D2 are bus stop positions (hållplatslägen) for city lines 2E, 10, 12, 13 and 21 (D1 towards Söder Tull/Vrinnevisjukhuset/Lindö/Rambodal, D2 towards Fridvalla/Åby/Ingelsta/Söder Tull). OSM's ways w287588687 (D2) and w287588703 (D1) are bus platforms, so they have no rail edges; they should be dropped from the train platform list rather than given edges.
